user.title: Larnitech connection
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to the controller. Native is recommended: writes are treated as a manual action and hold for ~10 minutes against automations. HTTP keeps the original behaviour.

reconfigure.title: Change Larnitech connection
reconfigure.description: Switch the transport or update connection details. Your entities are preserved.

native.title: Native protocol (TCP 55555)
native.description: Enter the controller IP. Leave the Access key blank to fetch it automatically from the controller's admin panel (admin/admin); otherwise find it in LT Setup → Security → Access key.

http.title: HTTP / WebSocket
http.description: Enter the IP address and API key for your Larnitech controller. The API key can be found in LT Setup → Plugins → API → Configure.

error.access_key_required: Could not auto-fetch the Access key. Enter it manually.

abort.wrong_controller: The Access details point to a different controller than this entry.
